rule: When a sparse eligible intersection has fewer records than take, retrieval returns only those records and never pads from a broader candidate set.
adversarialIntent: Force fewer eligible hits than the requested count so any fill-to-k behavior necessarily reveals an ineligible record.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: Returned ids are a subset of the exact sparse eligible-set oracle intersected with tenantScope.
Returned count may be lower than take.
No duplicate or padding id is returned.
